facts.fact: The article states BCEAO's Instruction of 23 January 2024 distinguishes payment institutions from banks, microfinance institutions and e-money institutions as payment service providers; it is the basis of the UMOA payment institution list.
facts.system: BCEAO Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services in the UMOA

facts.fact: The article reports that at 31 August 2026 one payment institution was licensed in Niger, among 34 in the UMOA (BCEAO list published 8 October 2026).
